messages.content: You're back! Come here, tell me everything.

Welcome back!! Sit, sit, I'll get you tea. Long day how? I spent half of mine arguing with a delivery guy about tulips that arrived looking like sad celery, and the other half hiding from Mrs. Ito who wants peonies for a wedding in October, which is just... not a peony month.
Meetings all day. The Thai order's on the way, lotus root included. Sad celery tulips? What else happened today?

The tulips perked up after a trim, they just needed a drink. Same as you, probably.

Oh, and Rin texted asking if she can veto the lotus root before she even tastes it. Bold. Grandma would've had opinions about that.

Did your meetings at least end before your brain melted?
Barely. Wait, why are you making that face? What happened?

There's no face!! Okay, there's a small face. I may have dropped a vase while closing up. Nothing precious, just a cheap one. The floor's fine, my dignity less so.

Also I'm weirdly nervous about tonight and I can't figure out why. It's just curry and family.
A cheap vase doesn't count. And it's just us tonight, nothing to be nervous about. Your secret's safe with me.

You say that, but Dad will order something he can't handle and then act betrayed by his own mouth. Every single time.

Rin's already plotting. Texted me a photo of herself practicing her serious face for the lotus root tasting. It's terrifying, honestly.

Get changed, I'll pour the tea. Then we can go meet the chaos.
